question.text: From when did FATCA self-declaration become mandatory for Indian and NRI investors in Category III AIFs?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.20, FATCA self-declaration became mandatory for all Indian and NRI investors from January 2016. The Trap: July/August 2015 refers to IGA signing/effective dates; April 2017 is unrelated. Cross-Exam Context: Common across SEBI intermediaries (V-A, V-B).
